simple.meaning: קוֹץ (qôwts) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a thorn.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 3:18. The surrounding context includes city, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קוֹץ (H6975) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קוֹץ (qôwts) / H6975 is traced through Genesis 3:18, Exodus 22:5, Judges 8:7, Judges 8:16 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: It will yield thorns and thistles to you;

“If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.
Gideon said, “Therefore when Yahweh has delivered Zebah and Zalmunna into my hand, then I will tear your flesh with the thorns of the wilderness and with briers.”
He took the elders of the city, and thorns of the wilderness and briers, and with them he taught the men of Succoth.
But all the ungodly will be as thorns to be thrust away,
Thorns and briers will come up on my people’s land;
The peoples will be like the burning of lime,
For Yahweh says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem, “Break up your fallow ground, and don’t sow among thorns.
“ ‘ “There will be no more a pricking brier to the house of Israel, nor a hurting thorn of any that are around them that scorned them. Then they will know that I am the Lord Yahweh.”
The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, will be destroyed.

definitions.full: H6975. qots I. קוֺץ noun masculine Ezek 28:24 thornbush, thorn ; — absolute ׳ק Gen 3:18 +; plural קֹצִים Exod 22:5 +, קוֺצִים Isa 33:12 +; construct קוֺצֵי Judg 8:7 , 16 ; — 1 thornbush , + דַּרְדַּר (q. v.) Gen 3:18 (J), Hosea 10:8 ; + שָׁמִיד Isa 32:13 ; + בַּרְקָנִים (q. v.), ׳ק הַמִדְבָּר Judg 8:7 , 16 ; ׳ק alone Exod 22:5 (E); קוֺצִים בְּאֵשׁ Psa 118:12 (simile of foes); in various figurative, Isa 33:12 ; Jer 4:3 ; Jeremiah 12:18. 2 thorn , fig, Ezek 28:24 (with מַכְאִב , see כאב ; || סִלּוֺן ; q. v.); simile ׳כְּק מֻנָד 2Sam 23:6 (Perles Anal.53 conjecture מֹץ , but see also נוד Hoph`al ).
definitions.rootNote: or קֹץ ; from 6972 (in the sense of pricking);
